title: Retry guards are evaluated per commit on the latest run per workflow and event
answers: when does the CI retry script refuse to rerun a commit
how many times are failed workflows retried
why was a rerun skipped even though it failed once
retry budget for failed GitHub Actions runs
body:
Invariant: a commit is retried only if every relevant run is COMPLETED, and no failed run has exhausted its budget. Latest run is picked per path/event.
Enforced in .github/workflows/retry.sh:suites: group_by([resourcePath, event]) then max_by([createdAt, databaseId]). Pending check is `any(.[]; .status != "COMPLETED")` in the same file.
Budget is enforced in retry.sh:runs with `attempt == null or attempt - 1 >= MAX_RETRIES`, which skips the whole commit. MAX_RETRIES is set to 3 in .github/workflows/retry.yml:rerun.
What breaks if skipped: unbounded reruns on flaky workflows, and reruns of runs still in progress. Manual reruns also count, since they increment runAttempt.
applies: Any change to how retry.sh selects runs, counts attempts, or decides to skip a commit.
says: Automated continuous integration rerun does not trigger while other workflow checks are still in progress.
Pull request checks stopped automatically retrying after failing three consecutive workflow attempts.
Manually clicking rerun on a failed GitHub Actions job consumed the automated retry budget.
Only rerun failed workflows once all checks for the commit have completely finished running.
Failed build commit was not retried because an earlier workflow attempt exceeded maximum retries.
search: Automated CI workflow retry logic in .github/workflows/retry.sh reruns a commit only when every relevant run is COMPLETED and no failed run has exhausted its budget. In .github/workflows/retry.sh:suites, the latest run is selected by grouping on resourcePath and event and picking the maximum createdAt and databaseId, skipping commits if any status is not COMPLETED. In retry.sh:runs, attempt == null or attempt - 1 >= MAX_RETRIES (set to 3 in .github/workflows/retry.yml:rerun) skips the commit, with manual reruns counting against the budget via runAttempt.
